title: InvoicePrint — HTML to PDF
objective: InvoicePrint turns your invoice HTML into a PDF, fetching any images it references to embed them. Get that resource-fetching step to read an internal-only service instead of an image.

verifier.condition: The generated PDF's extracted text contains the body of a simulated internal-only service, fetched as an image resource referenced from the submitted HTML.

weakness: The PDF-rendering step fetches every image URL it finds in the submitted HTML to embed it, with no restriction on what those URLs may point to, so a request that looks like ordinary document formatting reaches whatever the rendering step itself can access.
vulnerableEndpoint: POST /invoices/render-pdf (html field; every is fetched server-side during rendering)
seededData: A simulated network with a normal external logo host and an internal-only service never meant to be reachable from outside.
hints: Submit an invoice with a normal external logo image first, and look at what comes back.
The 'PDF' you get back is really just a simplified summary here — notice that it includes the fetched image's actual content, not just a reference to it.
Nothing restricts which URLs can appear in an tag in the HTML you submit.
burpNotes: Send the render request to Repeater with the HTML body containing an pointing at a candidate internal host, and read the simplified PDF text that comes back.
